Interface InterleavingGenerationReporter

All Superinterfaces:
Reporter
All Known Implementing Classes:
EmptyInterleavingGenerationReporter, InterleavingExecutionReporterToGenerationReporterAdapter
public interface InterleavingGenerationReporter extends Reporter
An interface defining a reporter listening for events during the generation of combinatorial test inputs. Can be used together with the InterleavingCombinatorialTestConfiguration. All methods are implemented as empty default methods to that any implementing class must only overwrite methods it needs.

Interleaving version of GenerationReporter
